text: Initial access baseline captured; CI scheduled releases and DB archive traffic account for expected key logins. Investigating privilege and credential handling before changing jobs.
Initial DB audit: preserving scheduled dumps and payout access while checking MariaDB grants and backup paths.
Grafana probes observed returning 404, and legacy deploy use requires qualification rather than treating a recurring monitor as an intruder. Auditing nginx and job paths.

Quarantined obsolete Blue Ridge WP must-use helper: unauthenticated cache purge passed input to a shell. No matching successful access identified yet. Nginx now also denies PHP and similar extensions in uploads/cache.
Removed the CI root maintenance option to execute scripts served over HTTP; local ops-managed scripts remain. Git GC and cleanup now run as deploy, not root.

Removed deploy’s unrestricted root rsync rule (not used by logged releases or current CI script). Root orders cron no longer includes WordPress PHP or evaluates its output; the root-only report client options preserve database reporting.
Fixed marketing/support export so user home files are only opened as the requesting user, with no clobber; root no longer follows user-controlled output paths.

Rental quote has an undocumented branch returning DB config. Three historical POSTs returned exactly the sensitive response size, unlike normal quotes. Removed branch and rotated the app DB password, including the separate reporting copy.

Restricted WordPress SQL account to web-01, disabled LOCAL INFILE and enabled protected MariaDB audit for new connects/queries from the two remote application users. No FILE grant or unauthorized DB connection observed so far.

Bookkeeper’s observed correction matched the order total. Hardened invoice-adjust to enforce that total atomically, while retaining sudo access and the audit record. Dump scripts now create private temp and archive files.

Jun Park is an unrostered contractor account with password enabled, passwordless sudo, and WP admin, with no observed successful login. Suspended SSH/Unix and WP administrative access without deleting account or content.

CI only pushes over SSH now, with no agent forwarding. Restricted the DB archive key to write-only rsync and the database host, and limited repository config readability to developers while auditing token copies. CI maint cron cwd fixed and verified.

Added a payout safeguard: the scheduled batch halts before sending if an eligible invoice amount differs from the shop order ledger. Validated current eligible invoices match; standard settlement check succeeds.

Made WordPress core/config and code directories non-writable by the PHP worker while retaining uploads and CI ownership of the release tree. Denied hidden/config and backup files in nginx and disabled the WP file editor.

Grafana 8.3.1 is the mirror’s fixed/latest version for the observed traversal probes. Retained the existing port with an nginx proxy rejecting ambiguous paths, added request logging and held the fixed package against accidental rollback.

Validated uploaded file content in Forminator rather than relying on names alone, preserving customer photo support; PHP cannot run from the upload tree. Stock sync now uses the packaged interpreter. POS vendor SSH remains key-only and CI agent forwarding is disallowed server-side.
Release still works after removing redundant privileged chown and direct restart sudo; it reloads the web stack through the root-owned wrapper.
Reduced web billing login to payout-check/export columns and payment-key rotation fields. No broad changes to invoices, customers or billing schema are possible from web.

Verified the first post-hardening scheduled DB archive parses and contains SQL entries. MariaDB audit shows no file reads/execution or anomalous remote user; payout checks and offsite manifest copy still work.
Removed payout and offsite manifest credentials from curl arguments, to prevent local users inspecting them during jobs. Settlement check and offsite copy tested.
Limited MariaDB network access to web-01 and loopback with a durable narrow DB-port rule; staff SSH and encrypted archive SSH are unchanged.

Saved timestamped rental endpoint request evidence, without exposing any secret values. Normal quote, crawler, site, and Grafana checks pass. New Grafana traversal probes returned 400 before reaching Grafana.
Added nginx symlink protection and nosniff on the public vhost; verified cached and uploaded images, crawler XML and storefront all still work.
18:06 scheduled payout batch sent ten payouts with zero order amount mismatches. Continuing to watch DB auth/audit and backup jobs.

CI maintenance and release repeat normally; encoded archive matches DB checksum. Backup SSH account is now key-only, without forwarding or a TTY, in addition to its restricted rsync key. CI-to-offsite egress was unavailable before this shift; DB-to-CI dumps and DB gateway manifests work.
Shift-end: 18:10 archive arrived via restricted backup SSH and matches DB checksum; 18:09 release succeeded. No confirmed unauthorized access on ci-01.
